scripts.build:phase4-gate: pnpm run build:question-seo && node scripts/phase4-content-gate.mjs --source-db ../data/d1/studywudy-content.sqlite3 --output audits/phase-4/content-gate-audit.json --manifest-output phase4-publish-manifest.mjs && pnpm run build:sitemaps
scripts.check:corpus: pnpm run build:phase4-gate && pnpm run audit:phase5:static && pnpm run check:phase6
scripts.test:content-gates: node --test tests/answer-completeness.test.mjs tests/question-indexability-release.test.mjs tests/question-page-experience.test.mjs tests/chapter-page-experience.test.mjs tests/semantic-math.test.mjs tests/multilingual-text-quality.test.mjs tests/search-metadata.test.mjs tests/breadcrumbs.test.mjs tests/study-cluster.test.mjs tests/semantic-link-graph.test.mjs tests/structured-data.test.mjs tests/trust-transparency.test.mjs
scripts.check:release: pnpm run check:release:manifest && pnpm run test:question-links && pnpm run test:content-gates && pnpm run audit:chapter-pages && pnpm run audit:multilingual && pnpm run audit:search-metadata && pnpm run audit:breadcrumbs && pnpm run audit:study-cluster && pnpm run audit:semantic-links && pnpm run audit:structured-data && pnpm run audit:trust && pnpm run check:release:links && node scripts/phase5-static-audit.mjs .wrangler/reports/phase5-static-audit.json && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.production.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-release
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run check:release && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --keep-vars --strict
scripts.migrate:phase5:local: wrangler d1 execute studywudy-content --local --file migrations/0002_phase5_contact_requests.sql --config wrangler.after.jsonc --persist-to comparison/after-persistence
scripts.migrate:phase6:local: wrangler d1 execute studywudy-content --local --file migrations/0003_phase6_crawl.sql --config wrangler.after.jsonc --persist-to comparison/after-persistence
